svg.title: Prediction Pool Application Vision — Class Diagram

g.text: Prediction Pool Application Vision — Class Diagram
One participation per user and pool.
{xor} Each round belongs to exactly one
Optional starting point with predefined rounds
and bets (e.g. Premier League or Oscars).
Creating a pool copies this structure;
the resulting pool can be customized independently.
At most one pick per participation and bet.
Both must belong to the same pool.
